newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bergen Brunswig raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bergen Brunswig raised.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it raised Bergen Brunswig Corp to a strong buy from a buy rating.
-- said termination of IVAX Corp merger agreement ends an ill-advised move.
-- said Bergen without IVAX is a well-positioned, solidly growing pharmaceutical wholesaler.
-- raised 1997 earnngs estimate to $2.10 a share from $1.80 with IVAX, compared to $1.83 in 1996.
-- lowered 1998 earnings estimate to $2.40 from $2.70 with IVAX.
-- sees stock trading in mid-high thirties near-term.
-- Bergen Brunswig stock traded up 1-1/4 to 32-3/4 in late morning trade.
